_: What each specimen actually is. specimens.json carries pixels and hinge coordinates; this carries the plant. Kept apart because a specimen can be remounted, rescanned or replaced without becoming a different species, and because plates.json already owns the other half of the question: which specimen stands for which app. Everything here is a plant in the beds at the house, from the Resource Central Garden in a Box sheets. 'beds' lists the plantings it appears in. Order is the accession order of the page.
